initial_prompt: Write a short, evocative poem about the feeling of nostalgia when finding an old, dusty photograph.

messages.content: Write a short, evocative poem about the feeling of nostalgia when finding an old, dusty photograph.

A single breath dispels the velvet dust,
To wake a ghost asleep inside a drawer.
A brittle edge of memory and trust,
A window to a day that is no more.

A summer trapped within the silver grain,
A smile suspended in the halted air.
The chest constricts with sweet, familiar pain,
To see the youth still breathing, unaware.

The years collapse along the fractured white;
Two eras gently touching in the hand.
I hold the past against the fading light,
A lonely traveler in a vanished land.
